whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Coffee & Cravings,

I noticed your café has incredible 4.9★ reviews from 200+ customers in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and menu page.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special menu showcase, aur Google Maps directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/coffee-cravings

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Coffee & Cravings team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and your amazing 4.9-star review showcase right opposite Aryabhatta Knowledge University in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact coffee menu aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
